card.name: Words just before "mechanism"
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers right before the word mechanism, such as "its", "the", "exact", "multiple" or "varying", and the start of "Mechanism" itself. It is strongest in "Based on its mechanism of action" and in interaction notes.

modes.label: Based on its
modes.description: The word "its" in the Embryo-Fetal Toxicity phrase leading into "mechanism of action".
modes.example: 5.5 Embryo-Fetal Toxicity Based on<< its>> mechanism of action, COLUMVI may

modes.label: Modifier before mechanism
modes.description: An adjective or article such as exact, the, multiple or varying that is followed by mechanism(s) in interaction or action statements.
modes.example: The<< exact>> mechanism for this interaction is not known,

modes.label: Start of Mechanism
modes.description: The first piece of the word Mechanism when it is split, as in a section heading.
modes.example: << Mechan>>ism and Clinical Effect Concomitant use

card.writes: It boosts the word mechanism (in several languages) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "mechanism", as in "mechanism of action" or "mechanism of this interaction".
